title: Travel document to return to Germany
summary: This page provides information on how to obtain a travel document to return to Germany if you are staying in Pakistan temporarily and have lost your passport.
application_process: Report to the Pakistani police station
Apply for a travel document to return to Germany
Seek approval for a new Pakistani visa with the Pakistani Ministry of Interior
processing_time: usually issued on the same day
important_notes: The travel document is only valid for one month
The application fee is 21.00 €

title: Application for a child's passport
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for a child's passport for German citizens in Pakistan.
eligibility: The child must be a German citizen
The child must be under the age of 12
required_documents: Present passport/ ID card of the child
Proof of the child's legal stay in Pakistan
Proof of the child's German Nationality
Marriage certificate of the child's parents
Divorce certificate of previous marriages of the child's parents
Birth certificates of the child's parents
application_process: Biometrics (for children from the age of 6)
important_notes: Appointments are required for application submission
The child's passport is not accepted by all countries (e.g. the USA)

title: Passports and ID Cards
summary: The page provides information on how to apply for a German passport or ID card in Pakistan.
required_documents: Civil status documents (especially birth and marriage certificates)
processing_time: at least seven months for document verification, approximately seven to ten working days for ID document production
application_fee: PKR 75,000 for verification of Pakistani documents, EUR 73.50 to EUR 128.00 for passport, EUR 70.60 to EUR 89.00 for ID card
validity: 6 to 10 years for passport, 6 years for ID card
important_notes: A child may not have acquired German citizenship at birth if one parent was born after 01.01.2000.
Documents issued by Pakistani authorities must be verified by a cooperation lawyer.

title: Update of place of residence in your passport
summary: If you have settled permanently in Pakistan, you need to have your place of residence updated in your passport.
eligibility: settled permanently in Pakistan
required_documents: proof of your legal stay in Pakistan
mandatory_prerequisites: proof of legal stay in Pakistan
important_notes: Updating the place of residence in your passport is free of charge.

title: Passport Application
summary: The page provides information on applying for a German passport or ID card in Pakistan.
eligibility: German nationality
application_process: Submitting your Application and Document verification
important_notes: Application by appointment only
All copies of your application have to be in Din A4 size, complete, readable, and not stapled

title: Consular Services
summary: The German Embassy in Islamabad and the German Consulate in Karachi provide various consular services, including notarizations, attestations, and certification of documents.
required_documents: Fee (cash in PKR) for issuing the Blocked Account Release Letter
Proof of an expired/cancelled visa (if applicable)
Withdrawn admission letter (certificate of registration) from the University in Germany (if applicable)
application_process: Book an appointment via the online link
application_fee: 36€ (around 12,000 PKR depending on the current exchange rate of the Embassy)
important_notes: The Embassy can give no guarantee for the content, quality or cost of translations
Prior contact to the bank is recommended to confirm that the Consular Attestation is necessary

title: Tourist visa for Germany
summary: The German Embassy in Pakistan provides information on the requirements and process for obtaining a tourist visa for Germany.
eligibility: Valid passport
Completed application form
Health insurance
Proof of accommodation
Flight reservation
Proof of financial resources
required_documents: Copies of previous passports and visas
Confirmation of employment or university enrolment
application_process: Fill out the application form on the Videx online application system
Print and sign the application form
Submit the application form and required documents
important_notes: The application can be rejected if any document is missing
The Visa Section can request additional documents at any time
The passport must be valid for at least three months after the end of the desired visa

title: Transit visa for Germany
summary: Pakistani nationals may require a visa for the international transit area of a German airport. The transit visa allows stay within the transit area of a German airport.
eligibility: Pakistani nationals
required_documents: Current passport and copies of all previous passports and visa
FRC (Family Registration Certificate), Marriage Certificate (if applicable), Birth Certificate (for minor applicants)
application_process: Fill out the Videx visa application form online and print it
important_notes: No airport transit visa is required for holders of diplomatic passports, family members of an EU or UK citizen, or people who hold a residence permit or visa of a Schengen state, a non-Schengen EU state, Andorra, Canada, Japan, San Marino, the United Kingdom, the United States of America, or a Dutch Overseas Territory.

title: Schengen Visa Application
summary: The Schengen visa is required for short-term visits to Germany and the Schengen area that last less than 90 days. Applicants must register online for an appointment and provide required documents.
eligibility: Short-term visits to Germany and the Schengen area
important_notes: Applicants whose biometrics have been taken during the past 59 months at any Schengen mission are exempt from personal appearance.
Registration on the waiting list is free of charge.

title: Visitor's visa for visiting friends and family in Germany
summary: This page provides information on the requirements and process for applying for a visitor's visa to visit friends and family in Germany.
eligibility: The applicant must have a valid passport with at least three months' validity after the end of the desired visa.
The applicant must have health insurance that covers all Schengen countries with a minimum coverage of €30,000.
required_documents: Current passport and copies of all previous passports and visa
Confirmation of employment or university enrolment in Pakistan and NOC for the trip
FRC (Family Registration Certificate), Marriage Certificate (if applicable), and Birth Certificate (for minor applicants)
application_process: Fill out the Videx online application system and print out the signed original.
Submit the application with all required documents.
important_notes: The applicant must provide all required documents in the correct order and format.
The applicant must disclose all previous visa refusals.

title: Visa for Medical Treatment
summary: This page provides information on the requirements for a medical treatment visa for Germany.
required_documents: Current passport and copies of all previous passports and visa
Invitation from the medical institution in Germany
Confirmation of employment or university enrolment in Pakistan and NOC for your trip
FRC (Family Registration Certificate) Marriage Certificate (if applicable), Birth Certificate (for minor applicants)
important_notes: The applicant must provide all the required documents in the correct order.
The applicant's passport must be valid for at least three months after the end of the desired visa.
The applicant must have a minimum insurance cover of € 30,000.

title: List of health insurance companies in Pakistan
summary: The page lists health insurance companies in Pakistan that comply with Schengen requirements. It also provides information on the minimum coverage required for Schengen travel insurance.
important_notes: The applicant is required to contract a full Schengen travel insurance, covering for a minimum amount of 30,000 euros.

health_insurance_companies: Chubb Insurance Pakistan Ltd (Formerly ACE Insurance Ltd)
PICIC - Pakistan Industrial Credit Investment Corporation
SPI Insurance Company Ltd (formerly Saudi Pak)

title: Business/Trade Fair/Exhibitor Visa
summary: This page provides information on the requirements for a business, trade fair, or exhibitor visa to Germany. It outlines the necessary documents and procedures for applying.
required_documents: Current passport and copies of all previous passports and visa
FRC (Family Registration Certificate), Marriage Certificate (if applicable), Birth Certificate (for minor applicants)
important_notes: Include all the documents listed below, in exactly the way described and in correct order.
Your application can be immediately rejected if you neglect to provide any document.
The Visa Section can at any time request any additional document from you.
Copies must be in A4 format.

title: Bonn Climate Change Conference - Visa
summary: The German Embassy in Islamabad provides visa appointments for the Bonn Climate Change Conference. Applicants must register on the waiting list and have all supporting documents ready.

Supporting documents for visa application

Book an appointment through the Embassy's appointment system
important_notes: Appointments can be allocated on short notice
Incomplete applications will not be processed

title: EU Blue Card
summary: The EU Blue Card is a residence and work permit for highly skilled workers from outside the EU. To apply, you need a valid employment contract with a company in Germany, a recognized university degree, and to fulfill one of the salary requirements.
eligibility: Valid employment contract with a company in Germany
Recognized university degree
Yearly gross salary of at least €48,300 (as per 2025) or €43,759.80 (as per 2025) with specific conditions

min_income_threshold.notes: Lower threshold of €43,759.80 applies under certain conditions

application_process: Familiarize yourself with the visa category and its requirements
Prepare your visa application using the provided checklist
important_notes: Check if you might qualify for another category if you do not meet the requirements for the EU Blue Card
A list of understaffed professions can be found on the make-it-in-germany website

enrollment letter for next semester

title: Research Visa Requirements
summary: The Research visa is for individuals with a hosting agreement or work contract with a research institute in Germany. The main requirements include a hosting agreement or work contract and sufficient financial means.
eligibility: Hosting agreement or work contract with a research institute in Germany
Sufficient financial means for living expenses in Germany
application_process: Register on the appointment waiting list
important_notes: Family members may apply for a family reunion visa
Further information about family reunion visa requirements can be found on the embassy's website

title: Family Reunion Visa for Germany
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for a family reunion visa to join a family member in Germany.
eligibility: Family members of German or EU citizens
Spouses of recognized asylum seekers or refugees
required_documents: Additional proof of name, birthday and marriage/relationship
application_process: Submit application via Consular Services Portal
Show original documents and pay application fee
application_fee: 75 Euros (payable in PKR) for adults, 37.50 Euros (payable in PKR) for children
important_notes: Due to long waiting times, some documents may no longer be valid at the time of application.
Applicants should only get new up-to-date documents once their appointment to apply for a visa is confirmed.

title: Long-term visa for Germany
summary: Information on long-term visa for Germany, including application process and requirements.

title: Financing your stay in Germany
summary: Information on how to show sufficient means to finance your stay in Germany, including blocked bank accounts, deeds of obligation, and scholarships.
eligibility: Sufficient financial means
important_notes: The German Federal Foreign Office has no influence on decisions of financial institutions.
A scholarship awarded by a Pakistani University is not sufficient, only a scholarship awarded by HEC can be accepted.

title: Language Course Visa Requirements
summary: This page provides information on the requirements for a language course visa in Germany, including necessary documents and application process.
eligibility: Registration for an intensive German language course
Proof of sufficient financial means
required_documents: Registration for an intensive German language course
Proof of language courses done in Pakistan (if applicable)
Letter of motivation (only for Consulate General Karachi)
Documentation of school, college and academic degree and employment history
Income proof and bank statements of last 6 months of yourself or of your sponsor in Pakistan (only for Embassy Islamabad)
Information about any previous visa refusals
Information provided to applicants pursuant to Section 54 (2) 8 in conjunction with Section 53 of the Residence Act
Appointment confirmation e-mail (only for Embassy Islamabad)
mandatory_prerequisites: Registration for an intensive German language course

important_notes: Please note that all copies of your documents have to be in DIN A4 size, complete and readable, and not stapled.
You have to arrange each set of documents according to the order in which they are mentioned below.
Please provide two sets of A4 size photocopies.

title: Au-Pair in Germany
summary: Information for au-pair applications at the German Consulate-General Karachi.

Hosting family is not of Pakistani origin and consists of at least one child under 18 years old
Applicant is between 18 and 27 years old
Applicant has never done an au-pair in Germany before
Applicant has German language proficiency level A1 CEFR
required_documents: Proof of German language proficiency level A1 CEFR
mandatory_prerequisites: German language proficiency level A1 CEFR

Submit application through the Consular Services Portal

title: National Visa
summary: The National Visa is a long-term visa for a specific purpose, usually granted for 90 days to one year. After entry, a domestic residence permit must be applied for.
eligibility: langfristigen Aufenthalt (über 90 Tage)
application_process: Füllen Sie bitte das Visum-Antragsformular aus
Stellen Sie bitte die begleitenden Antragsunterlagen zusammen
Buchen Sie bitte einen Termin, um Ihren Antrag zu stellen
important_notes: Die deutsche Auslandsvertretung prüft und entscheidet über Ihren Antrag
Für diese Prüfung ist abhängig vom Reisezweck eine Bearbeitungsdauer bis zu drei Monaten möglich

title: Visa Application for Afghan Applicants
summary: The German Embassy Islamabad accepts visa applications from Afghan applicants. Applicants must book an appointment via the German Embassy Kabul website.
application_process: Booking an appointment via the German Embassy Kabul website
important_notes: Applicants must book an appointment via the German Embassy Kabul website
Registrations/ booking of appointments via the website of the German Embassy Islamabad cannot be accepted and will be cancelled

title: General Information on Visa Applications
summary: The German Embassy in Pakistan provides information on visa applications, including processing times and fees.
important_notes: The remonstration procedure for visa rejections is cancelled indefinitely and without prejudice starting on 1st July 2025.
The Embassy cannot print a visa in passports that are not signed.

title: Complaints about the Schengen visa application process
summary: Schengen visa applicants can submit complaints about the conduct of the consulate staff or the visa application process.
important_notes: Complaints may only be submitted in German or English.
No legal remedies against decisions to refuse, annul or revoke a visa may be submitted via the complaints contact form.

title: List of lawyers, doctors and translators
summary: The page provides a list of lawyers, doctors, and translators. It is part of the consular services offered by the German embassy in Pakistan.

title: Zoll
summary: The page provides information about consular services, specifically the German customs office.

title: Important note to our visitors
summary: The German Missions in Pakistan provide consular services, and applicants must book appointments and follow specific procedures.
important_notes: Applicants must book appointments online and ensure they have all required documents.
Mobile phones and bags are not allowed in the buildings of the German Missions.
Be cautious of 'agents' offering to check applications and demanding high prices for their services.

title: Consular Services
summary: The German Missions in Pakistan offer various consular services, including visa applications. Applicants must book an appointment online and choose the correct category to avoid being sent away.
important_notes: Applicants must use the Visa Navigator to determine the right category for their visa application.
Afghan applicants should refer to the website of the German Embassy Kabul.
